messages.subject: Error in configureMCMC
parts:
Dear Nimble Team,

When using a gamma distribution as informative prior, I get this message in configureMCMC:
Error: internal error #1 in cc_expandDetermNodesInExpr method

Using other distributions (normal or uniform) the same code runs fine.
I'm using nimble version 1.0.2.

Best regards,
José
